Corrections are about research OBJECTS (metadata, summary, classification

## Research record

- DOI (if known):
- Title:
- Link / identifier:

## What is incorrect?

Which dimension is affected — and remember these are kept **separate**:

- [ ] Metadata (authors, journal, year, DOI, identifiers)
- [ ] Summary / abstract accuracy
- [ ] Outcome classification
- [ ] Evidence quality
- [ ] Criticism
- [ ] Provenance / source
- [ ] Other:

## Describe the correction

What is wrong, and what should it be?

## Evidence / source

Provide the authoritative source supporting the correction (DOI, publisher page,
open-access link). Please respect source terms — do not attach copyrighted PDFs.

## Additional context

Anything else reviewers should know.
